article.title: Eligibility for re-election
article.content: A person who holds, or who has held, office as President shall, subject to the other provisions of this Constitution, be eligible for re-election to that office.
article.html:
57Eligibility for re-election

Article 57 · Part V · The President and Vice-President

A person who holds, or who has held, office as President shall, subject to the other provisions of this Constitution, be eligible for re-election to that office.
